xopenexhfa.title: Xopenex HFA is an effective short-acting rescue inhaler for the treatment of asthma in children, adolescents, and adults
xopenexhfa.excerpt: Xopenex HFA (pronounced zō-pen-eks) is a kind of medication known as a rescue bronchodilator, which is a quick-relief treatment option to relieve symptoms during an asthma attack. The medicine, taken via inhaler, works by relaxing tightened muscles around the airway passages, helping to relieve coughing, wheezing, shortness of breath and chest tightness caused by asthma.

zegeridotc.title: Zegerid OTC® - Zero Heartburn. Just 1 Pill Per Day*
zegeridotc.excerpt: Zegerid OTC® is the only 24-hour frequent heartburn treatment that contains two active ingredients: the leading prescription acid reducer (omeprazole), plus a second ingredient (sodium bicarbonate) that protects the omeprazole from acid in the stomach — so it can be absorbed by the body and get right to work treating frequent heartburn.
